name: 048_tv_macd_strategy
hypothesis: TradingView port (PLAN.md section 13), TradingView's own built-in 'MACD Strategy'. Its logic: MACD(12, 26) minus its signal EMA(9) crossing zero marks a change of momentum; long on the cross up, short on the cross down. Defaults kept: 12 / 26 / 9, close. DEVIATIONS the engine forces: the TradingView version stays in the market and only reverses on the opposite signal; the engine has no stop-and-reverse and every trade must risk 1%, so a pct stop and a time stop are added and are the only grid keys. TradingView's default commission is 0; here it is 0.05% taker + 0.02% slippage + funding. Source chart 4h; variants in chart mode (the same bar counts on every chart).
